supported_repairs: Stop cancels the actual unfinished live-cleanup HTTP call and does not queue remaining live phrase requests; recognized text and accepted corrections remain.
Explicit after-stop polishing uses one combined transcript with existing lossless chunking, within one 2500ms budget; stalled/failed polish preserves recognized words.
Streaming keyboard updates retain the confirmed common prefix and replace only the changed tail, preserving UTF-16 pairs and external anchors.
Explicit-offset keyboard windows corroborate exact node text and absolute cursor positions when they cover the whole mutation; unknown offsets remain full-text only.
Placeholder resolution rebinds the initial mutation range to the resolved owner. Existing initial selection behavior is preserved.
Actual unacknowledged-commit state prevents closing the stream before UI counter callbacks; audio drain and final transcripts remain mandatory.
One foreground service remains Ready across apps and through delivery, promoting to microphone only after a dictation tap. Hardware Stop precedes removal of the microphone service type.
Ready notification offers Hide; active capture offers Stop; finishing offers Cancel. Hide/disabled accessibility stop readiness; Reset position restores it. No idle mic or API connection.
Unchanged notification text is not reposted on every transcript update. Stop-phase metadata distinguishes recognition, polish and saving without speech logging.

test_evidence.http: Real OpenAiClient and coordinator on loopback; injected non-secret key and transcript fixtures. Stalled request cancellation observed on the actual Call; no remaining live cleanup requests after Stop.
test_evidence.stop_bounds: Default stalled-cleanup fixture completes within a 1000ms assertion after Stop. After-stop fixture uses one full transcript request and completes within its 3500ms assertion after takeRequest. These are test-environment bounds, not provider/device latency promises.
test_evidence.editor: Production bridge, native EditText/InputConnection and bounded surrounding-text IPC fixture. Long existing and owned drafts preserve anchors/cursor, with changed-tail commits. OS broker/remote IPC/selection callbacks are simulated.
test_evidence.background: Production coordinator/transport/service foreground and notification paths at Robolectric SDK 33/35; hardware boundary simulated for release ordering. No idle microphone transport constructed by Ready.

preserved_contract: Typing during dictation, including composing words without waiting for a space
Same-field ownership, protected keyboard edits and cancel/field-switch safety
gpt-live-transcribe minimal delay, 20ms native PCM frames and parallel startup
Approved silver artwork verified by packaged bytes
Opt-in vocabulary, short no-reasoning cleanup and per-recording validated memo
limitations: Installed Chrome/Fold6 behavior and the screenshot’s exact node/keyboard mismatch were not reproduced; offset/range defects are verified under controlled native fixtures.
No physical microphone, installation, Samsung persistence, paid provider performance, latency or invoice measurement was performed.
Protected/password fields remain excluded; unsupported editor integrations cannot be claimed as all-input-box compatibility.
specialUse subtype and permission are declared, but Google Play approval and production launch are unverified.
Sponsor-paid trial backend, expiry and spend controls remain outside this release.

prior_gates.classification: Introduced stale required range after placeholder resolution plus removal of original initial selection dispatch. Repaired without changing expectations or extending test deadlines.

prior_gates.note: Intermediate candidate; final release adds microphone-before-ready ordering and SDK33/35 regression.

delivery: Signed installable APK saved successfully, original update certificate matched, all 25 ZIP payload entries unchanged by signing; local file identity applied and SHA256 unchanged after save.
